name: conductor-mod
description: Conductor: a live pane for orchestrated Claude Code sessions

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Comma-separated TIER=regex (case-insensitive) mapping models to T0-T3

prices.title: Prices (est)
prices.description: Comma-separated regex=input/output/cacheRead in $ per 1M tokens, for estimates only

contextAmber.title: Context amber %
contextAmber.description: Context gauge turns amber at this percent

contextRed.title: Context red %
contextRed.description: Context gauge turns red and says 'checkpoint now' at this percent

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated, in order: progress, crew, plan, workflow, servers, architect, gate, log

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: mini inline above the prompt or under 40 columns, hybrid otherwise. hybrid: hybrid on every docked pane (inline above the prompt is always mini, 8 rows). mini: mini everywhere

maxBoxes.title: Worker boxes
maxBoxes.description: Worker boxes side by side before they fold into rows (1-6)

architectPattern.title: Architect pattern
architectPattern.description: Case-insensitive regex for agent types and server tools that count as the architect

gateLabel.title: Gate label
gateLabel.description: Name shown for the permission strip

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme; pastel is fixed colours for dark terminals

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show progress, ETA, context, running workers, flags and live servers in the status line
